recipe.native_source: Run the exact native_source_generator at native_source_arguments; all circuit nodes are integer arithmetic operations.
recipe.B: Tensor product of the free rank-four point blocks over the retained integer polynomial ring.
recipe.c_j: sign times the product of odd_factor_nodes in quadratic_reductions; original root = square_multiplier * new root.
recipe.T: Product of the nodes in support_factor_bounds, each once; nonzero fixed integer factors are omitted.
recipe.Z: 2+sum of squares of the nonleading coefficients of every point_quartic
recipe.final: input.X*P when multiply_by_input is true; otherwise P
recipe.semantic_scope: Delta=0 gives P=1. Delta!=0 gives exactly a rational character of the guarded native source. Existence of a full-unit witness for every integer input is proved separately; equivalence at every original base tuple is NOT asserted.
recipe.basis_order: Lexicographic tensor basis in point-block order (1,U,V,W), followed by square exponents 0,1 in pole order.

arithmetic_scope: The sufficient parameter and arithmetic assumptions of the source are unchanged.
